name: Alcudia de Veo (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alcudia de Veo (a red shield with a blue eye within a bordure compony of white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Alcudia de Veo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcudia de Veo arms — eye within a compony bordure
